verdict.rationale: Token2 describes several of its software tools as open source: the desktop companion app, the mobile companion app and the libfido2-based fido2-manage utility. The fido2-manage and Entra ID bulk-enrollment repos are public on GitHub, so their source is readable. However, no license is named anywhere in the pack, and nothing shows that the core security-key firmware is open. Missing for 10: an explicitly named open license (e.g. MIT/BSD/GPL) for the repos, open-source evidence for the key firmware, and independent corroboration that all claimed open-source apps have public source.
